test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: LCNT is related to NEPV in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HBER is related to JDGT. To which of the following is OSCF related to following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• LCNT is written as NEPV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a3e4d83088e47f673d8c1ec0056ff50c81194c0263a8b3dbc2bcb0d11e87b3a.png] 

And,

 
• HBER is written as JDGT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/204dcb17ce19f50725d8aebc42fc1ae1fd44b1b470e822c3cb608c91c204196a.png] 

Similarly,

 
• OSCF is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cebb2f35af0100ae0187fc67922106c313744d0d7e56f219f07e51c504c97f28.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**QUEH**".

2f:T
